## Details

<a id="instruments"></a>
### [`instruments`](../../../../src/music/instruments.asm#L6) `$A21A-$A50D`

*data*

Instruments of command $f3, 12 bytes each (63 entries). Command $f3 n reads entry n at $a21a+12n. Bytes 0-3: attack/decay, sustain/release, waveform with inverted pulse width high, inverted pulse width low. Bytes 4-5: effect delay, effect flags. Then 3 phases: value, length. No tune uses instruments $2f, $30, $36, $38 and $39.

- **Referred to by:** [`cmd_instrument`](commands.md#cmd_instrument)
